new_candidates.legal_basis: Proposed ordinance(s) under consideration by Defiance City Council: (1) a 12-month moratorium on review/approval of data center development applications, and (2) a zoning text amendment classifying data centers, data center campuses, and data warehousing as conditional uses under M-1/M-2/M-3 districts (and power-generating facilities as conditional under M-3). Not yet adopted.
new_candidates.trigger: City officials began researching data center zoning gaps in February 2026; no pending data center applications were reported, but a nearby property proposed for annexation (west of the Menards store) drew organized resident opposition.
new_candidates.current_status: Pending. A special council session on data center zoning and the proposed moratorium was quickly adjourned on 2026-07-28 due to venue overcrowding and accessibility complaints; a larger-venue public meeting was rescheduled for 2026-08-05.
new_candidates.affected_projects: No pending data center applications reported; resident opposition led by Rebecca Rupp centers on a property proposed for annexation west of the Menards store.
new_candidates.outcome: Undetermined; contingent on the outcome of the rescheduled August 5, 2026 public meeting, which had not yet occurred as of the 2026-07-31 research date.

evidence.title: Defiance council quickly postpones meeting on data center matters
evidence.supports: Defiance City Council is considering both a zoning text amendment (conditional-use classification for data centers under M-1/M-2/M-3) and a proposed 12-month moratorium on data center development applications; a July 28, 2026 special session was adjourned early and a public meeting rescheduled for August 5, 2026.
evidence.quote: Council will consider a 12-month moratorium on the review and approval of any application for a data center development within city boundaries.
